description: This PHP class defines a custom form field type named 'TitleType' in the Goteo project, extending Symfony's AbstractType. It customizes form options and view variables related to the display and behavior of the 'title' form element.

classes.name: TitleType
classes.description: A custom form type extending Symfony's AbstractType to represent a title field with specialized options.

methods.name: configureOptions
methods.description: Sets the default 'row_class' option for the form type.

methods.name: buildView
methods.description: Configures the form view variables, setting 'row_class' and 'type' to customize rendering.

methods.name: getBlockPrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix string used in form block naming, here 'title'.
